'''Magistrate of Revelry''' was a title in the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] held by [[Indo Zal]], a socialite and entertainment event organizer for [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]].<ref name="Kotet 6">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=6}}</ref> The title was sometimes referred to as the '''High Imperator of Revelry'''.<ref name="Coronation">{{TORcite|type=message|A Coronation for the Ages!|Indo Zal}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
